text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] high 5xx rate observed on /v1/generate in eu-west-1 · 2255554321

incident-bot: alert details — metric: api.errors.5xx.rate; region=eu-west-1; value=12.4% (baseline ~0.3%); triggered rollout-fallback-policy

Alex (oncall): I need to hand this over — I'm heading offline in 10m. Priya, you're up next as primary.

Priya (oncall-2): on it. quick status?

Alex (oncall): timeline so far:
- 22:05 UTC: spikes start, small number of customers seeing errors
- 22:07 UTC: automated circuit-breaker opened for backend-encoder-eu
- 22:09 UTC: routing fallback to smaller model tier attempted (gpt-small-eu) but some requests still hit gateway errors
- 22:12 UTC: started rolling restart of gateway-eu-west-1 (k8s) to clear stuck connections
- current: rolling restart in progress (3/8 pods restarted)

Maria (SRE): observed logs show gateway returning 502 from proxy -> backend connection resets. snippet: 
```
[22:11:58] gateway-eu-west-1: upstream reset stream: connection reset by peer (errno=104)
[22:12:03] encoder-pool-3: socket hang up during kv fetch
```

Sanjay (infra): quick infra note — noisy pod restarts correlated with kernel OOM events on a couple of worker nodes earlier today; we patched kernel constraints but some pods are still unstable. I'm checking node health now.

Priya (oncall-2): actions I'm taking now:
1) continuing rolling restart (kubectl rollout status) and monitoring 5xx trend
2) temporarily increase routing to fallback pool: set routing.policy.fallback_weight=0.6 for eu-west-1
3) disable autoscaling burst to avoid reintroducing noisy pods (`as-config set eu-west-1 --burst 0`)

Alex (oncall): also FYI — three enterprise customers reported errors: AcmeDocs (high), HealthAnalyzer (medium), FinSight (low). CS notified via support-escalations.

Priya (oncall-2): noted. I've posted a brief to support: "We're investigating elevated 5xxs in eu-west-1; mitigation in progress, ETA 10-20m. Will update."

incident-bot: escalation: pager sent to Maria (SRE) & Sanjay (infra) due to infra tags on alert.

Maria (SRE): I'm on the bridge. quick checks:
- KV cache hit rate looks normal
- backend machines show increased socket timeouts to encoder service
- will try toggling keepalive settings on the gateway to reduce connection churn

Sanjay (infra): I've flagged two nodes with OOM events: eu-node-12, eu-node-15. Draining eu-node-12 now; cordon + drain to move workloads off.

Priya (oncall-2): small playbook snippet I'm running (from runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/region-fallback):
```
# handoff mitigation steps
1) enable fallback routing: redwoodctl routes set --region eu-west-1 --fallback-weight 0.6
2) restart gateway (rolling): kubectl rollout restart deploy/gateway-eu-west-1 -n inference
3) monitor api.errors.5xx.rate and route.response.latency > if >3% after 15m -> escalate to infra pager
```

Alex (oncall): coverage note — EU overnight shift has only 1 dedicated oncall tonight. If Maria needs infra deep-dive we'll be relying on Sanjay as secondary. No additional SREs in APAC to help for now.

Priya (oncall-2): mitigation progress: restart progressed to 6/8 pods; 5xx rate down from 12.4% -> 5.1% in last 3m. Still above threshold. Next: try toggling keepalive and drain eu-node-15 if OOMs persist.

Maria (SRE): toggled gateway keepalive to 60s -> earlier spike of resets reduced on one pod. recommending we keep fallback routing for 30m to ensure stability, then slowly reduce weight.

Sanjay (infra): eu-node-12 drained successfully; no new OOMs on eu-node-12. eu-node-15 shows memory fragmentation — I'll open a ticket for kernel upgrade in maintenance window and live migrate workloads off for now.

Priya (oncall-2): immediate customer impact summary for handoff:
- AcmeDocs: heavy error rate, feature degrade for their document generation flows. CS paged and assigned priority P1.
- HealthAnalyzer: intermittent failures, using retry logic client-side, lower impact but monitoring.
- FinSight: occasional 502s for batch requests.

Priya (oncall-2): handoff to next shift — I'm primary until 2255557921 (end of my shift). Alex will be backup until 2255556000 (local overlap). Maria + Sanjay are on-call for infra escalation.

Priya (oncall-2): outstanding tasks for next oncall:
- keep fallback routing enabled for at least 30m after 5xxs drop below 1%
- verify no further OOMs across eu nodes for 1h
- follow up with infra ticket for kernel patch eu-node-15 (Sanjay)
- prepare post-incident notes and customer timeline after full resolution

Alex (oncall): thanks — one last note: if 5xxs spike again after restart, remove routing to encoder-pool-3 and pin to encoder-pool-1/2 as a short-term measure. Command: `redwoodctl pools set --region eu-west-1 --exclude encoder-pool-3`

Priya (oncall-2): acknowledged. I'll update this thread with timeline and final resolution once we get below 1% sustained. leaving markers: #handoff #incident #eu-west-1

incident-bot: reminder scheduled — check 5xx metric in 10m and post update to thread.

(End of thread update at 2255554620)
